textRuns.value: Targets & the CFO read — what each verdict card is checking
Liquidity: current ratio healthy at 1.5–3.0x (< 1.0x = trouble; far above 3.0x = capital sitting idle) · quick ≥ 1.0x or bills depend on selling inventory · cash ≥ 0.2x for immediate cover.
Solvency: debt/equity above ~2.0x means lenders own the downside · interest coverage ≥ 3.0x comfortable, < 1.5x danger · net debt/EBITDA vs the 2.0x policy is the borrowing ceiling.

D&A % of revenue: > 8% = capital-intensive — CFO reviews capex discipline, asset utilization, impairment risk, and whether depreciation schedules match real asset lives; < 3% = asset-light OR under-investing — check CapEx ÷ D&A: at 1.06x here the asset base is being replenished slightly faster than it wears. Margins: contribution < 20% = thin pricing power; > 50% = high operating leverage (volume swings amplify profit).
